scope: Resolution of N3-EN-R1, N3-EN-R2 and N3-EN-R3 in five changed prose text fields and the directly affected section boundary only.

resolutions.observation: The system is now explicitly the body or material chosen for study, with everything outside it defined as the surroundings. Heat is energy transfer caused by a temperature difference. Work is another energy-transfer route, illustrated by pushing, compressing and stirring. The first law positively relates the change in stored energy to net heat and work transferred into a system that exchanges no matter. This supplies the missing closed-system energy account without treating heat/work as stored substances or claiming every energy transfer changes temperature.
resolutions.resolution: The original explanation gap is resolved; no further repair is required for R1.

resolutions.observation: Heat capacity now describes the energy needed to raise the chosen body's temperature by one degree under stated conditions and without a phase change. The text concerns that body's heat capacity, not specific heat per unit mass. Experimental measurement and the fact that thermodynamic laws alone do not provide every body's heat capacity remain explicit. The defined property gives the following unchanged discussion an intelligible referent.
resolutions.resolution: The missing definition is supplied while retaining the material-property and experimental comparison; no further repair is required for R2.

resolutions.observation: Model is now defined as a simplified description whose assumptions fit the body and conditions. The one-temperature versus different-part-temperatures example makes that limitation concrete, and explicitly avoids asserting that Earth, a steel rod or every illustrated body always has one uniform temperature. Classical particle motion is tied directly to Newton's laws, with a conditional quantum-effects caveat rather than unlimited applicability. The concluding comparison replaces appropriate regime with the suitability of the microscopic model and system conditions. The qualifications are now connected to a positive explanation rather than unexplained bulk/regime language; the substantive scientific limits remain.
resolutions.resolution: The model and applicability explanation requested by R3 is supplied in the three assigned fields; no further repair is required for R3.
